title: Geometric hypotheses
statement:
For the global finite-field datum [def-weil-finite-field-fiber]
$(p,a,q,k_0,k)$, let $Y_0$ be a finite-type
[def-weil-finite-type-morphism] $k_0$-scheme. It is *smooth of pure
dimension $d$* if $d\in\mathbf Z_{\geq0}$, the structure morphism $Y_0\to\Spec
k_0$ is a smooth morphism [def-sbc-smooth-morphisms], and $Y_0\times_{k_0}k$ has pure dimension $d$
[def-weil-pure-dimension]: every irreducible component [def-weil-irreducible-components] of
$Y_0\times_{k_0}k$ has Krull dimension [def-kun-dimension] $d$. It is *proper* if its structure
morphism is separated, of finite type, and universally closed, i.e. it is a
proper morphism [def-weil-proper-morphism]. It is *geometrically connected*
[def-pc-geometrically-irreducible] if it is nonempty and
$Y_0\times_{k_0}k'$ [def-pc-base-change] is connected [def-weil-connected-scheme] for every field extension $k'/k_0$,
equivalently [lem-weil-geometrically-connected-algebraic-closure] if its geometric fiber $Y_0\times_{k_0}k$ is nonempty and
connected.
